title: Monograph about the care pathway for sleep apnea
core_idea: A research monograph mapping and analyzing the care pathway for sleep apnea, focusing on prescribed treatments and their distribution, numbers of CPAP and MAD prescriptions, and aspects of CPAP compliance and appraisal.
tldr: Research report detailing the care pathway for sleep apnea and examining prescribed treatments, CPAP and MAD prescription counts, and CPAP compliance and appraisal.
